description: SEC mutual fund / ETF lookup — Look up a mutual fund or ETF share class in SEC EDGAR by ticker= (e.g. VFIAX), or series= (S000...) or class= (C000...): CIK, series and class IDs, sibling share classes, the registrant trust (name, location), number of series in the trust, latest date of each fund filing type (NPORT-P holdings, N-CSR reports, 485BPOS/497K prospectus, N-CEN) and the 15 most recent fund filings with links. Public-domain SEC data. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
